description: Find overlapping work hours across time zones.

faqs.a: They are fixed UTC offsets (UTC−05:00, UTC+05:30 and so on) with no daylight-saving rules, so the conversion is simple arithmetic: local time = your time + offset difference. That means it will be off by an hour for regions currently on DST.
faqs.q: Why fixed offsets instead of real time zones?

faqs.a: A slot counts only if the whole meeting — from its start to start plus length — falls inside 09:00–17:00 for every zone, including yours.
Yes — each of the four zone selectors has a 'None' option. Pick at least one.
faqs.q: Can I use fewer than 4 extra zones?

howto: Add up to 4 other UTC offsets.
Set the meeting length in minutes.
Press Find slots — green rows work for everyone between 09:00 and 17:00.
